scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names ENGINE,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev -w @kstock/trading-engine" "npm run dev -w @kstock/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kstock/trading-engine && npm run build -w @kstock/web && node scripts/desktop-launcher.mjs --mark-build
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names ENGINE,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run start -w @kstock/trading-engine" "npm run start -w @kstock/web"
